messages:
maya: starting staged rollout: rwd-infer v2.3.1 -> 20% (eu+us). change window until 21:00 UTC. watch: eu-west 5xx, embed quality, p95. stop if eu 5xx > 0.7% for 5m OR p95 +100ms for 5m. ack and monitor.

deploy-bot: [automated] kickoff job=job-4756 target=20% ver=v2.3.1 regions=[eu,us] dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/job-4756

chris: saw eu-west 500s ~0.6% last 2m; tokenizer WARNs (tokenizer v2.0.4) in logs. digging traces.

ada: tailing traces and logs. if stays <0.7% for 5m we proceed; otherwise hold+rollback.

maya: pausing any further ramp. /deploy pause job-4756

deploy-bot: job-4756 paused by maya. traffic fixed at 20%. rollback cmd: /deploy rollback job-4756 --to v2.3.0

sre-team: telemetry: p95 +40ms vs baseline, infra healthy. error budget low but aligns with tokenizer warnings. recommend hold and observe.

chris: opened PR to pin tokenizer for canary: https://git.redwood/infer/PR-1423 (pin tokenizer->v1.9 for canary cohorts). includes tests + rollback steps.

maya: adding ops note in release notes for fallback tokenizer and rollback playbook.

ops-bot: release notes updated: "v2.3.1: staged rollout includes tokenizer fallback; if eu 5xx >0.7% for 5m rollback to v2.3.0 and pin tokenizer v1.9 for canary" https://docs.redwood/release-notes/v2.3.1

maya: hold for 10m then reassess. execute rollback if thresholds breach. acks?

ada: ack \\ monitoring.

chris: ack \\ ready to merge PR and rollback if needed. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: snapshot: eu 5xx=0.59%, us 5xx=0.03%, p95 delta=+38ms. paused awaiting manual resume/rollback.

maya: thanks all. end-of-hold decision in 10m.
